description: A major step has been taken by the state government to increase transparency, efficiency and ease of information in government operations. The government is now going to launch a central portal with AI-based search functionality to make all laws, rules, resolutions, notifications and circulars available
body_lead: - English News - Local - Gujarat - Gujarat Govt Launches AI based Central Information Portal Citizens Will Get One click Access To Laws, Resolutions, Circulars & Notifications Across 26 Depts Gujarat govt launches AI-based central information portal:Citizens will get one-click access to laws, resolutions, circulars & notifications across 26 depts - Copy link A major step has been taken by the state government to increase transparency, efficiency and ease of information in government operations.
